statements.impact_statement: Upstream buildkit v0.30.0 (buildctl) and railpack v0.23.0 binaries in the worker image embed grpc-go 1.80.0/1.79.3. The vulnerable surfaces are the grpc xDS RBAC filter and HTTP/2 server, which these CLI invocations do not expose as network listeners. No upstream releases built with the patched grpc 1.82.1 exist yet; drop this statement on the next buildkit/railpack version bump (mirrors the .trivyignore.yaml entry).
